description: Record the Bitty dependency relationship and bitty-lua Host ABI boundary in phodopus/docs (issue #4). Deliverable: a new document under docs/ per the owner directive that Phodopus primary documentation lives in phodopus/docs. Suggested docs/integration/bitty-host-abi.md with a route-only docs/integration/README.md, or a specification-type page under docs/specifications/ if it fits the existing taxonomy better (state the choice). Content: (1) dependency relationship - Bitty consumes Phodopus as an independent general-purpose Rust dependency; Phodopus core stays host-agnostic and Bitty-agnostic; bitty-lua is the only Bitty-specific consumer layer (Phase 5: bitty.ui, bitty.panel, bitty.command, bitty.fs); (2) host ABI boundary contract - no Bitty-specific abstractions and no hard Tokio/async-std in the VM core; async host ops cross as typed HostOp::Pending(handle) with the host adapter driving the future and resuming the coroutine; (3) text-layout separation - utf8.* measures code points; graphemes/emoji modifiers/East Asian double-width belong to the terminal host layer (bitty.text); (4) deferral - bitty-lua implementation is deferred until Phodopus is usable; Bitty's accepted mlua/Lua 5.4 runtime contract is unchanged until then; (5) integration expectations - which Phodopus capabilities Bitty depends on for the switch (module resolution/require, string.format, patterns, utf8, traceback, async bridge, hard memory quotas/Fuel), each tied to the owning spec in this corpus. Follow docs/development/documentation-workflow.md spines for the chosen document_type. status: accepted only for genuinely decided relationship/boundary rules; mark anything undecided candidate/open. Wire into docs/README.md content trees and any relevant topic index. Cross-repo pointers by absolute URL to bitty-docs ADR-0012, bitty-plugins-docs runtime/phodopus-runtime-candidate.md, bitty-terminal-docs specifications/phodopus-host-abi-candidate.md as consumer records without duplicating content. Constraints: English; self-contained (no research record numbers); no file://; do not change existing accepted spec claims; just check green; worktree+branch ctx-XXXX/<type>-<slug>; stop at in_review.
title: docs(integration): record Bitty dependency relationship and bitty-lua Host ABI boundary
